messages.subject: Random Walk with covariates
parts:
Hi all,

I see that Inla has an ar1C model, for an AR1 model that has covariates which affect the trend. Is there a similar ar2c or rw1c, rw2c, etc as well?

Alternatively, is there a way of using the already in-built functions to do a similar thing - include dynamic covariates which impact the change from one time step to the next?


Thanks,
Evan

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Random Walk with covariates
parts:
its only implemented for AR1 at the moment.


note that the formulation in AR1C is slighly different from
AR1+covariates, as you directly change the innovations in AR1C, where
in AR1+covariates you alter the mean only.

you can add this yourself, using R, with rgeneric, or even add your own
C code.

see the vignette about rgeneric
